visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Various prepped ingredients are laid out on a beige cutting board and a white tray in a bright kitchen. Broccoli florets topped with carrot sticks are in the tray. On the board, sliced zucchini, celery stalks, garlic cloves, sliced chili, and raw pork strips are neatly arranged alongside pieces of dried tofu. (2) A woman's hand opens a refrigerator drawer revealing fresh cabbage and grapes. Then, the camera cuts to the woman opening wooden cabinets. Inside, clear plastic bins hold various packaged dried goods; she reaches for a bag of dried herbs. (3) The scene shifts to cooking actions: pork is placed into an air fryer basket, a whole fried fish is lifted from a pan, and a hand adds fermented black beans to a container. A plate of cooked ribs is slid into an oven, while a pot of clam and corn soup boils. (4) The woman, wearing a cream sweater and a beige apron, chops broccoli on a grey board. Close-ups show packaged food items like Sun Moon Lake Red Tea Tofu and Chunhua Silken Tofu along with a carton of eggs on the counter. (5) The woman holds a smartphone in a black floral case, using it to film the ingredients on her kitchen counter. She looks down at the screen, then at the camera, smiling slightly with a soft expression. (6) Close-up shots focus on CASETiFY accessories. Two phone cases are shown—one with white flowers on a black background and another with a dark floral pattern. A pearl-beaded phone strap with a bow is displayed prominently. (7) The woman holds up her phone, showing off the mirror-finish phone case. She smiles and gestures with the phone towards the lens. The kitchen background is slightly blurred but appears clean and well-lit. (8) The woman is back to cooking, pouring oil and cracking an egg into a pan. Her phone is propped up nearby. She then shows the phone case again, demonstrating its durability by holding it while pretending to talk. (9) A close-up shows the phone propped up on a black Magsafe stand on top of a kitchen container. The screen displays a digital recipe for stir-fried pork with celery and tofu. (10) Rapid cuts show the woman chopping celery, chili peppers, and dried tofu into uniform pieces. She then chops zucchini slices and adds seasoning from a white container into a bowl of mixed vegetables. (11) The woman stir-fries the ingredients in a large stainless steel pan using a white spatula. She pours soy sauce from a bottle. The camera captures the steam and vibrant colors of the broccoli and meat mixture. (12) A promotional slide for CASETiFY appears with black and red text details. The woman is seen attaching a card holder to her phone before the final shot of the phone standing on the counter.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 要煮飯不難. (2) [Subtitle]: 最難的是菜色搭配. (3) [Subtitle]: 有時候煮菜沒有靈感時. (4) [Subtitle]: 我會從冰箱或者是乾貨區. (5) [Subtitle]: 有什麼可以組合的. 先從主菜開始思考. (6) [Subtitle]: 通常是蛋白質類的. (7) [Subtitle]: 肉類要蔥爆或者烘烤/燉煮/紅燒. (8) [Subtitle]: 青菜一份至兩份. (9) [Subtitle]: 其他的就從蛋啊還有豆腐之類的去聯想. (10) [Subtitle]: 我是媽媽. 也是一個創作者. (11) [Subtitle]: 媽媽平常的菜色搭配就已經很燒腦了. (12) [Subtitle]: 在在 CASETiFY 的雙11 狂歡祭 可以讓我輕鬆的自由搭配. (13) [Subtitle]: 個性化的手機殼跟配件. (14) [Subtitle]: 這次我挑了兩款. (15) [Subtitle]: 都是超可愛的印花手機殼. (16) [Subtitle]: 鏡面款還可以當補妝鏡用. (17) [Subtitle]: 最重要是CASETiFY的強悍防摔手機殼. [Logo]: Duo-Lock by CASETiFY™ 防護科技. (18) [Subtitle]: 有通過高防摔測試. (19) [Subtitle]: 可以讓我邊料理邊拍攝時 拿在手上很有安全感. (20) [Subtitle]: 搭配卡套支架配件. [Logo]: 超強磁吸/可攜帶單張卡片/穩固站立. (21) [Subtitle]: 還可以讓我一眼輕鬆的看到手機上的食譜. (22) [Subtitle]: 有人問我 常常做菜都不會感到累或厭倦嗎. (23) [Subtitle]: 因為是真心喜歡的啊. (24) [Subtitle]: 有時候搭配出不一樣菜色. (25) [Subtitle]: 家人愛吃 自己也開心. (26) [Subtitle]: 我覺得手機殼就像新菜色一樣. (27) [Subtitle]: 不同搭配 每天看著又有不一樣的心情. (28) [Subtitle]: 為忙碌的媽媽生活增加一點新意. (29) [Subtitle]: CASETiFY 的雙 11 狂歡祭活動. [Logo]: CASETiFY 雙11狂歡祭 最低享 4 件 65 折 購買指定型號享 6 折!. (30) [Subtitle]: 有多種優惠. (31) [Subtitle]: 更詳細的優惠資訊都放在底下. (32) [Slogan]: CASETiFY 雙11狂歡祭 活動期間: 11/03 - 11/14. (33) [Subtitle]: 趕快來逛逛吧.

Background music is an upbeat, mid-tempo acoustic pop track featuring rhythmic guitar strumming. Distinct percussive sounds of a knife hitting a wooden cutting board are rhythmic and sharp. (2) The narration continues steadily as cabinet doors creak and slide open. A high-pitched electronic beep from an oven is heard, followed by the soft bubbling of liquid in a pot. The BGM remains consistent in volume and energy. (3) The rhythmic chopping sounds return, coinciding with the narrator's professional tone. Ambient kitchen noise is minimal, with high clarity in the vocal track. (4) The woman's voice becomes slightly more animated while discussing brand features. Soft rustling of materials and the light click of a phone being handled are audible over the steady acoustic guitar rhythm. (5) Technical kitchen sounds intensify: the crisp crack of an eggshell, a liquid splash, and a metallic clink. The sizzling sound of food hitting a hot pan adds a high-frequency texture to the mix. (6) A rapid sequence of percussive chopping sounds is followed by the continuous scraping of a spatula against a metal pan. The narrator's tone sounds joyful. The BGM maintains its major-mode, positive atmosphere. (7) The narration concludes with a clear call to action as the music maintains its volume. A final soft click or thud is heard before the audio track cleanly ends.
